card.name: Lab value units before a lab term
card.fires_on: Partway through lab-value expressions, such as the unit after a glucose number (mg before /dL), the start of BUN, or the digits in a concentration or GFR cutoff. It also fires on words like blood or Monitor right before a lab measure.

modes.label: Units after a number
modes.description: The unit or number part inside a lab concentration or kidney-function cutoff.

modes.label: Start of BUN
modes.description: The first letter of BUN in lists of lab tests or reports of elevated BUN.
modes.example: elevated<< B>>UN occurred more frequently in patients receiving cele

modes.label: Word before a lab measure
modes.description: A word that leads into a lab test name or blood measure.
modes.example: Zileuton increases warfarin levels.<< Monitor>> prothrombin time and adjust war

card.writes: It pushes toward lab-measure words like saturation and hem-, and away from words meaning elevated.
card.plain: It fires inside lab values and test names, such as mg/dL, BUN and GFR cutoffs, where the next word is a lab measure.
